popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book 1 opens on Chryses' daughter: Agamemnon's refusal to return Chryseis brings Apollo's plague, and her ransom is the first quarrel that unmakes the Achaean camp.

popCulture.title: Chryseis
popCulture.description: The priest's daughter of Chryse remains the Iliad's opening wound — the captive whose release costs Agamemnon his honor and Achilles his prize.
